title: xi dats ability action
description: Publish a composed ability presentation (job ability / spell / weapon skill built by `xi ability compose` from a recipe — schema ability_recipe.json) into ROM10 with a new animation number. `dats new` (Ability) and `dats prepare recipe.json --type ability` write it; `dats build` composes the recipe, places the DAT(s) and registers their file ids.

kind.description: What the client looks the DAT up as. auto = from the recipe: a race-bound `ws:` lane publishes as a weapon skill (per-race extended slot), a `spell:` motion as a spell (file_id 0xAF0 + animation), anything else as a job ability (file_id 4412 + animation).

animation.description: Animation number the server row will carry. auto = the first free one: job abilities from 339, spells the first unregistered from 1012, weapon skills the first extended slot (264–271) whose DAT is a retail dummy on every race.

subdir.description: ROM10 folder the DAT(s) are placed in (first free file numbers).

force.description: Repoint an animation number that is already registered (never done on its own).

emit.description: Write the server SQL snippet to projects/server/abilities/<id>_<animation>.sql.

result.description: Recorded by dats build: the allocation the action landed on.
